sn45.20:1.3: katamaṃ nu kho āvuso brahmacariyaṃ? katamo brahmacārī? katamaṃ brahmacariyapariyosānanti?
sn45.20:1.5: bhaddako kho te āvuso bhadda ummaggo, bhaddakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ, kalyāṇī paripucchā.
sn45.20:1.6: evaṃ hi tvaṃ āvuso bhadda, pucchasi.
sn45.20:1.8: katamaṃ nu kho, āvuso brahmacariyaṃ, katamo brahmacārī, katamaṃ brahmacariyapariyosāna”nti?
sn45.20:1.10: ayameva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo brahmacariyaṃ seyyathidaṃ:
sn45.20:1.12: yo kho āvuso iminā ariyena aṭṭhaṅgikena maggena samannāgato,
sn45.20:1.14: yo kho āvuso rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo,
